ROLE:
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Data Cloud Lead to own the operational stability, governance, support, optimization, and roadmap execution of the Salesforce Data Cloud platform within a complex enterprise ecosystem.The role will serve as the primary technical and functional SME for Data Cloud, supporting customer profile unification, identity resolution, data ingestion, segmentation, activations, and customer intelligence use cases.The successful candidate will lead Data Cloud support operations, drive platform adoption, support business stakeholders, and manage transition activities from an incumbent service provider. This role requires a strong combination of Data Cloud architecture, data engineering, production support leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Key Responsibilities Data Cloud Platform Ownership Act as the primary Data Cloud SME and platform owner. Govern platform configuration, architecture, scalability, and operational processes. Establish Data Cloud governance standards and operational procedures. Drive continuous optimization of customer data models and activation strategies. Ensure platform reliability and business continuity. L3 Production Support Leadership Serve as the highest technical escalation point for Data Cloud incidents. Lead diagnosis and resolution of Sev-1 and Sev-2 issues impacting customer data processes. Investigate: Data ingestion failures Identity resolution inconsistencies Segmentation issues Activation failures Data quality problems Drive root cause analysis and preventive remediation actions. Develop operational monitoring and support frameworks. Customer Data Model Governance Own Customer 360 data modeling standards. Design and maintain: Data Model Objects (DMOs) Custom Data Models Data Relationships Business Rules Data Governance Standards Ensure consistency and quality across customer master data domains. Identity Resolution & Unified Profiles Lead design and optimization of identity resolution strategies. Troubleshoot: Match rule issues Reconciliation issues Duplicate customer profiles Profile fragmentation problems Improve customer profile accuracy and completeness. Data Ingestion & Integration Support Support data onboarding and ingestion from multiple enterprise systems including: Salesforce Core Clouds SAP Contact Center Platforms Enterprise Data Lakes External Applications Middleware Platforms Responsibilities include: Data stream monitoring Data pipeline troubleshooting Transformation validation Data reconciliation Error remediation Segmentation & Activation Support Own operational support for: Customer Segments Calculated Insights Activation Targets Marketing Data Consumption Customer Service Use Cases Ensure data is correctly activated across downstream channels and business systems. Data Quality & Governance Establish data quality monitoring processes. Identify and remediate: Missing customer data Data duplication Identity conflicts Synchronization failures Data integrity issues Define operational controls and governance standards. Stakeholder Leadership Partner with: CRM Teams Customer Service Teams Marketing Teams Enterprise Data Teams SAP Teams Analytics Teams Translate business requirements into Data Cloud capabilities and platform enhancements. Transition & Knowledge Takeover Lead Data Cloud transition activities from incumbent vendors. Assess existing implementation quality and technical debt. Review: Data Streams Data Models Identity Rules Calculated Insights Segment Logic Activations Build support documentation and runbooks. Required Experience Overall Experience 6-8 years of IT experience. Minimum 3 years working with Salesforce Data Cloud. Minimum 2 years supporting enterprise-scale Customer Data Platforms. Experience in Managed Services or Production Support environments. Mandatory Salesforce Experience Strong experience with: Salesforce Service Cloud Salesforce Platform Customer Data Architecture Data Governance Security Model Integration Frameworks Candidate must understand how customer data is generated and consumed across Salesforce ecosystems. Mandatory Data Cloud Expertise Hands-on experience in: Data Foundations Data Streams Data Lake Objects Data Model Objects Unified Individual Data Harmonization Identity Resolution Matching Rules Reconciliation Rules Unified Profiles Consent & Privacy Considerations Activations Segmentation Activation Targets Customer Audience Management Insights Calculated Insights Data Transformations Customer KPIs Must have independently built and supported Data Cloud solutions. Data Engineering Competencies Strong knowledge of: Customer Data Platforms (CDP) Data Lake Concepts Data Warehousing ETL/ELT Processes Data Modeling Customer 360 Architectures Experience with: SQL Data Quality Frameworks Data Reconciliation Processes Enterprise Integration Understanding Although not the Integration Lead role, the candidate must understand how Data Cloud interacts with: Salesforce Service Cloud SAP Contact Center Systems Middleware Platforms Data Warehouses Marketing Platforms Must be capable of troubleshooting data flow issues across multiple systems. Certifications Mandatory At least one: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant Salesforce Administrator Strongly Preferred Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant Salesforce Data Architect Salesforce Application Architect Platform Developer I AI Associate AI Specialist #LI-Hybrid

ROLE:
We are seeking a highly experienced Salesforce Managed Services Technical Lead to provide L2/L3 support, platform governance, and continuous improvement for a global Salesforce-based Contact Center ecosystem. The successful candidate will act as the highest technical escalation point for production support and will own complex issue resolution across Salesforce, CTI, enterprise integrations, SAP-connected processes, and Data Cloud use cases. This role is not focused on project delivery alone. The primary expectation is operational excellence, high-severity incident management, root cause analysis, platform stabilization, and technical leadership during transition from the incumbent support organization. Requirements: Production Support Leadership Serve as the senior-most L3 technical escalation point for Salesforce-related production incidents. Lead troubleshooting of Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents, ensuring rapid service restoration and stakeholder communication. Drive post-incident root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent corrective actions. Own problem management backlog and platform stabilization initiatives. Establish proactive monitoring and preventive maintenance processes. Contact Center & CTI Ownership Troubleshoot and optimize Salesforce CTI integrations. Analyze agent desktop, call routing, screen pop, omnichannel, softphone, and telephony integration issues. Support integrations between Salesforce and telephony platforms. Diagnose cross-system issues spanning: Salesforce CTI platform Middleware Telephony infrastructure External systems Integration & Enterprise Systems Support Lead troubleshooting of real-time and batch integrations. Investigate failures involving: SAP Middleware platforms APIs Platform Events CDC External REST/SOAP services Analyze integration logs and transaction failures across multiple systems. Provide design recommendations for improving resiliency and observability. Salesforce Platform Governance Review and approve complex technical changes before production deployment. Conduct architecture and code reviews for enhancements entering production. Guide developers on best practices for: Apex LWC Integration Architecture Data Modelling Security Ensure platform scalability and operational stability. SAP Migration Support Collaborate with SAP migration teams to assess downstream impacts on Salesforce. Support testing and migration activities affecting customer service operations. Identify integration and data synchronization risks during migration programs. Data Cloud & Customer Data Management Support Data Cloud-related troubleshooting and data ingestion processes. Investigate identity resolution, data harmonization, segmentation, and activation issues. Analyze customer data quality issues impacting business operations. Transition & Knowledge Acquisition Drive technical knowledge transition from incumbent vendor teams. Document current-state architecture, integrations, dependencies, support procedures, and operational runbooks. Identify technical debt, support risks, and platform vulnerabilities during transition. Experience & Certifications Overall Experience 7-9 years of Salesforce experience. Minimum 3 years supporting business-critical Salesforce production environments. Minimum 2 years acting as L3 support lead or technical lead in AMS/Managed Services engagements. Salesforce Expertise Strong hands-on expertise in: Apex Lightning Web Components (LWC) Flows Platform Events Change Data Capture Asynchronous Processing Salesforce Security Model Service Cloud Omnichannel Contact Center Experience (Mandatory) Minimum 3 years of experience with at least one: Salesforce CTI Amazon Connect (optional) Genesys Cloud NICE In Contact (Optional) Five9 (Optional) Avaya Cisco Contact Center Must demonstrate troubleshooting experience and not just implementation exposure. Integration Expertise (Mandatory) Hands-on experience supporting integrations involving: REST APIs SOAP APIs(Optional) Middleware platforms Event-driven architectures Enterprise Service Bus patterns Must have experience troubleshooting production integration failures. SAP Integration Exposure (Mandatory) Experience supporting Salesforce integrations with SAP landscapes including one or more: SAP ECC SAP S/4HANA SAP CPI SAP PI/PO Data Cloud Exposure (Highly Valued) Experience with: Data Cloud Data Streams Identity Resolution Calculated Insights Activation Data Governance Certifications Salesforce Certified Application Architect and System Architect. Strongly preferred: Platform Developer II Integration Architect Data Architect, Sharing & Visibility Architect Identity & Access Management Architect. Data Cloud Financial Service Cloud Good to have (optional) Cloud Consultant Certifications: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud Experience Cloud #LI-Hybrid
